violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed food employee handling her personal phone, then grabbed clean dishes to put away without washing her hands between the two tasks. Hands should be washed after touching personal items and before handling clean dishes.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Empty sanitizing bucket was found overturned in the hand washing sink. Handwashing sinks should be easily accessible at all times.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelving under pizza pan storage and next to the front hand washing sink were found dirty. Shelving should be cleaned and maintained clean.
